Scope: Hide only the outer System Options vertical scrollbar while retaining access to all settings
PreExistingWorkPreserved: All earlier version-display, caption/search, ribbon and reference-workbench UI changes and their dated evidence
Implemented: SystemPropertiesPanel outer ScrollViewer uses VerticalScrollBarVisibility.Hidden rather than Auto or Disabled
No rail, thumb, arrows, hover reappearance or reserved scrollbar column; wheel and focus-driven keyboard scrolling remain enabled
Sidebar horizontal scrolling stays disabled; lens-table and ribbon scrolling are unchanged
Standing project preference and current UI guides updated; supersedes the previous stage's reserved-column choice without rewriting its evidence

Tests.NewCaseCoverage: Light at 240 DIP/13 and 280 DIP/18; Dark, Pixel and Isekai at 256 DIP/13. Actual mouse-wheel input and Tab-driven focus navigation move the vertical offset without exposing the scrollbar, enabling horizontal scrolling or changing the document revision.
Tests.ExistingCompositionCoverage: Six production-control compositions additionally assert the outer vertical scrollbar is hidden and input right edges remain within the viewport.

RenderedControlFixtures.Mechanism: Dedicated ReferenceWorkbenchLayoutTests processes with Skia/HarfBuzz, not native desktop screenshots
RenderedControlFixtures.Observation: No outer sidebar scrollbar or reserved column; visible input/card right outlines remain intact.
RenderedControlFixtures.Boundaries: Uses the existing real-control composition fixture, not a complete MainWindow action matrix. Earlier Dark-caption fixture observation remains scoped to its own ledger; this change makes no fix or native acceptance claim for it.

IntermediateResults: Initial test build could not copy the default App output because the verified running main application held it. Closed only that instance normally and rebuilt the default outputs.

First completed five-case run failed because nested TextBox scrollbar template parts shared the same name. Limited the lookup to bars whose nearest ScrollViewer ancestor is the sidebar; original TRX retained as hidden-sidebar-first-completed.trx.

Second five-case run passed wheel checks but failed an End-key assertion while a Button held focus. Replaced that unsupported test gesture with actual Tab/focus navigation, without adding product shortcuts; hidden-sidebar-second.trx retained.
Corrected focused run passed 5/5 (hidden-sidebar-third.trx), then both final 57-case runs and both six-case capture runs passed. Intermediate counts overlap and are not additive.
Limitations: No full product/laboratory/numerical suite or new Zemax capture
No native manual desktop, multi-monitor DPI or ARM64 acceptance
No installer rebuild or installed-product replacement
DeliveryAtValidation: Default runnable Debug and Release application outputs updated; uncommitted working tree
